# premium-saas-web

> Open-source Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Google Antigravity) to build premium SaaS, AI-product, agency and portfolio websites. It contains 4 design directions, 18 copy-ready CSS/HTML recipes and a GSAP + Lenis motion system measured from top-selling ThemeForest templates. MIT licensed. Made by MiddleSugar7000, a full-stack developer for hire.

Install for any agent: `npx skills add MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill`

Benchmark (Claude Opus 5.5, 4 one-line prompts, isolated runs, no memory): 97.5% of automated design-quality checks passed with the skill vs 75% without. That costs about 11 min and $2.70 per page vs 2.3 min and $0.70.

## Skill files
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/SKILL.md): workflow, page rhythm, self-review checklist, anti-patterns
- [directions/](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/tree/main/skills/premium-saas-web/directions): Ember Dark, Tactile Light, Editorial Mono and Noir Spotlight, one folder each (tokens + signature techniques)
- [shared/light.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/light.md): sculpted glow, backgrounds, hairline grid
- [shared/typography.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/typography.md): display type, line-by-line scroll-fill text
- [shared/product-proof.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/product-proof.md): browser mockup, bento mini-UIs
- [shared/components.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/components.md): glass nav, badges, marquees, pricing, footer wordmark
- [shared/logos.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/logos.md): real brand logos instead of letter placeholders
- [shared/motion.md](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/skills/premium-saas-web/shared/motion.md): GSAP, ScrollTrigger, SplitText and Lenis setup, with gotchas

## Install guides
- [Claude Code](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/guides/claude-code.md): ~/.claude/skills/ or plugin marketplace
- [OpenAI Codex](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/guides/codex.md): ~/.codex/skills/
- [Cursor](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/guides/cursor.md): ~/.cursor/skills/ or .cursor/skills/
- [Google Antigravity](https://github.com/MiddleSugar7000/premium-saas-web-skill/blob/main/guides/antigravity.md): ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/ or .agents/skills/
